scatter_inner: scatter data into a target tensor at a specific timestep if a mask is true
scatter: scatter data into a batched target tensor at timesteps with per-element masks using vmap
scatter2: scatter data into a batched target tensor with a single mask per batch using vmap
scatter_prefix: scatter data into a target tensor at all positions before a timestep if mask is true
scatter_suffix: scatter data into a target tensor at all positions from a timestep onward if mask is true
